_notes.purpose: Accepted ERC/DRC counts from the CI KiCad image (kicad/kicad:10.0.2). Gate is a ratchet: errors fail on ANY change up or down; warnings fail on increase. This is not 'accepting errors' — every entry is a reviewed, documented false-positive or deliberate design choice, and the strict gate forces a conscious review before the set can change. Refresh only inside the CI image via --update-baseline, in the same commit as the design change that justifies it.
_notes.error:courtyards_overlap: H1 mounting hole vs WROOM antenna keepout — nylon-screw mitigation (bring-up.md).
_notes.error:items_not_allowed: 2 items in the antenna keepout rule area (same H1 corner).
_notes.warning:lib_footprint_mismatch: Vendored/custom footprints differ from stock KiCad lib metadata; library not installed in the container. Cosmetic.
_notes.warning:silk_overlap: Cosmetic silk-on-silk; dense board. 44 (was 43) since the D1 TVS rotation moved its polarity band north to mark the +5V pad, where it grazes a neighbor's silk — intrinsic to that correctness fix.
_notes.drc_parity: Name/metadata residue (dual-label net-name picks, stale auto-names on label-less 2-pin nets, one stale PCB LCSC field). Electrically inert; fab outputs are netlist-driven. Cleanup queued in ROADMAP.
